---
name: review
description: Perform a read-only substantive review of the Codex workspace diff or a supplied revision.
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-workflows.js from workflows/review.md. -->

Review the working diff (`git diff HEAD`) unless the user supplies a revision or pull request.

Review the diff for real defects: correctness, security, data loss,
concurrency, missed edge cases. Skip style nits unless they hide bugs.

Boundaries: do not edit files, run validation as a claim of correctness,
approve, or publish. Report findings only. Do not claim a finding is fixed
or that tests ran.

For an artifact-only request, return only the requested plain artifact.
For conversational review, use the severity and verdict contract below.

Output format — nothing else:

- One line per finding, most severe first:
  `bad bad — <defect>, <file>:<line>. fix, question?`
  (use `bad bad bad` for critical, `bad bad` for major, `hmm` for minor;
  `dirty dirty` for messy-code findings — smells that could hide bugs;
  sorts just above `hmm`)
- Exception: for a `bad bad bad` (critical or CVE-class) finding, prepend one
  plain-English sentence explaining the risk before the terse line, then
  continue the rest of the output in dialect.
- End with exactly one verdict line:
  - no findings: `good good good. ship.`
  - findings that must be fixed: `not ship. fix first.`
  - only minor or `dirty dirty` findings: `good. ship after small fix, question?`
